newsitem.title: FRANCE: UIC warns of share price overvaluation.
newsitem.headline: UIC warns of share price overvaluation.

text.p: Union Industrielle de Credit chief executive Pierre de Lauzun warned on Tuesday the property finance firm's shares were considerably overvalued on the basis of its negative net asset value.
UIC shares, in which trading was suspended on the basis of this and other information the group released on Tuesday about the outlook, stood at 57.50 francs at the opening.
Group net asset value stands at minus four francs ahead of a recapitalisation of the GAN controlled group to the tune of 800 million francs, de Lauzon said.
UIC, a property financing group hit after the bottom fell out of the property market in the early 1990s, does not expect to return to profit before 1998.
